title: MongoDB
body:
A document-oriented [[NoSQL]] database. Instead of tables with a fixed schema, it stores **collections** of **documents** — BSON, essentially [[JSON]] — and two documents in the same collection need not have the same fields.

That flexibility is the selling point and the catch. Application objects can be persisted more or less as they are, with no object-relational mapping layer and no [[Database Migration]] needed to add a field. But nothing stops inconsistent shapes accumulating, and there's no [[JOIN]] in the [[SQL]] sense — related data is either embedded in the parent document (fast to read, awkward to update in many places) or referenced by id and fetched in a second query.

It's the M in the MERN stack, paired with [[Express]], [[React]] and [[Node.js]].
